title: Cross-examination near-duplicate/leakage triage, source-verified selected images
research_status: Completed retrospective research source-quality audit; no independent patient or clinical validation

full_population_coarse_dhash.limits: Every cross-examination dHash distance counted, but coarse hash proximity alone is not a duplicate, clinical lesion or patient identity

original_image_pretrained_embedding_scre.source: Previous verified ImageNet MobileNetV3-Small feature bank; no newly trained model or pixel acquisition
original_image_pretrained_embedding_scre.algorithm: Exact cosine similarity search in 256-image batches; five most similar source images from different examination IDs, evaluated for each source image

private_original_pixel_followup.selection: All 551 unique top-five cross-examination pairs with cosine >= 0.92, threshold fixed for this descriptive follow-up
private_original_pixel_followup.method: 64x64 full-field RGB area resize; grayscale pixel-aligned SSIM and full/central normalized RGB MAE; same strict rule used in the prior PR #48 audit

scientific_decision: No strict close pixel-aligned copies among the 551 strongest screened cross-examination embedding pairs; additional evidence against obvious source duplication, but independence remains unverified. No AI model promotion.
next_high_value_dependency: Custodian-backed patient-to-video linkage and acquisition device/site provenance; then qualified independent diverse-positive source exams, not repeated model tuning on the known pool.
